About Our College
Welcome to Brahmaputra Degree College
The The Brahmaputra Degree College was established in the year 1993 by the educational zeal of the visionaries and by the dedicated efforts of the local community of greater kherkata area belonging to the Dhakuakhana sub division, in the Lakhimpur
district of Assam, with Bakulguri as its centre of location........
Read
                                More
Our Vision
To make accessible for all, affordable and excellent centers of higher education in order to create an environment of acquiring academic knowledge and skill development
with high social values.
Our Mission
To provide affordable but value based and quality education by identifying hidden talents in their respective chosen streams and provide opportunities to realize their full
potential in order to shape them into accomplished and capable persons of the country.
Our Aim
To impart highest standard of education through value based holistic teaching andlearning by imbibing traditional and innovative practices. To create platform for exploring creative potential and give shape to their ideas.
 Inculcate a strong belief in hard work and core values of gender equality, human rights and ecology in order to make them socially responsible citizens. To equip students with skills needed to adapt better to the changing global scenario and gain access to various career opportunities.
 To guide the students all along in the course of their journey through life and
transform their dreams into reality.
